payload.text: WP11 work is uncommitted in the shared tree: src/plan.rs and src/workbook.rs (new); plan and apply-plan in src/sync.rs; the plan and workbook mods in src/lib.rs; rust_xlsxwriter and calamine in Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock; AT-11.1, the warm-up removal and PPLR_TODAY=GOLDEN_NOW in tests/cli.rs; the WP11 skips and uv guards in tests/pplr_sync.bats; shared strings in tests/golden/xlsx-cells. The shared tree does not build until dc's Config::now is on main (src/sync.rs calls config.now()). Nobody else should edit or commit these paths until cc commits WP11: a --only commit of src/lib.rs, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock would sweep WP11's lines in. No bin/ or lib/ file is touched, so hv's live pplr is unaffected.
